Bundles Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, ComfyUI, and RAG into a single local stack. Instead of manually stitching together local AI tools, ODS turns your PC or Mac into a private AI server. It handles model inference, voice, agents, and image generation with no cloud dependency.
Up 260 stars over seven days.
